description.value: Wild North Brewing Co. is a craft brewery and taproom in Creston, BC, situated just off Canyon St in the heart of the Creston Valley. The brewery emphasises locally sourced ingredients and an authentic approach to craft beer, pouring its own lineup in a taproom with a patio and a lively events calendar that includes trivia nights and community gatherings. It is a natural social hub for cyclists passing through the Kootenays on a longer touring route.
